notes: Public AI-infrastructure and high-multiple software names that the market prices on growth and compute exposure rather than near-term earnings — the closest listed analogues to a frontier-model lab.

Card networks and payment processors that share Stripe's take-rate economics and volume-driven revenue; GPN stands in for Adyen, which needs FMP global coverage (Starter is US-only). Lower illiquidity discount reflects Stripe's pre-IPO scale.

Cloud data-platform and consumption-revenue software peers — Snowflake and Confluent are the most direct lakehouse/streaming analogues, with Datadog and Elastic rounding out the data-tooling comp set.
